XX/XX/year> : Attempted to deposit 2 checks into a Capitol One approved atm located at XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX, IL XXXX.

I asked that the case be reopened as that reason did not make sense since I was able to call the bank, they should be able as well.
